questions.stem: Methane gas is burnt in air. State whether the reaction is exothermic or endothermic.

Which of the following reactions is exothermic? (A) Quick lime is dissolved in water to produce slaked lime. (B) Calcium carbonate is heated to produce carbon dioxide gas and quick lime. (C) Lead nitrate is heated to produce lead oxide, nitrogen dioxide and oxygen. (D) Mercuric oxide is heated to produce mercury and oxygen.
